what: Wire `blaze fix` into the CLI (blaze-cargo): for each workspace member, load the crate into the front end and call blaze_lints::fix::fix(&mut db, krate, &setup, name_of); write Fixed.files back through the VFS; print FixError (it names file:line and lint) and exit nonzero on Err. `blaze fix --replace A=B` is the same edit with no lint: blaze_intent::retarget::Retarget with `to` mapping the item at A to B (agree the shape with tests-misc, who build Edit::Replace). Then turn std_lock/std_mpsc/fx_hash on in [workspace.metadata.blaze.lints] once blaze_hash exists.
